/**
 * Computes the chart area metrics for the current panel size.
 *
 * @return The chart area metrics.
 */
private ChartAreaMetrics computeChartAreaMetrics() {
    Dimension size = getSize();
    Insets insets = getInsets();
    Rectangle2D available = new Rectangle2D.Double(insets.left, insets.top,
            size.getWidth() - insets.left - insets.right,
            size.getHeight() - insets.top - insets.bottom);

    boolean scale = false;
    double drawWidth = available.getWidth();
    double drawHeight = available.getHeight();
    this.scaleX = 1.0;
    this.scaleY = 1.0;

    if (drawWidth < this.minimumDrawWidth) {
        this.scaleX = drawWidth / this.minimumDrawWidth;
        drawWidth = this.minimumDrawWidth;
        scale = true;
    }
    else if (drawWidth > this.maximumDrawWidth) {
        this.scaleX = drawWidth / this.maximumDrawWidth;
        drawWidth = this.maximumDrawWidth;
        scale = true;
    }

    if (drawHeight < this.minimumDrawHeight) {
        this.scaleY = drawHeight / this.minimumDrawHeight;
        drawHeight = this.minimumDrawHeight;
        scale = true;
    }
    else if (drawHeight > this.maximumDrawHeight) {
        this.scaleY = drawHeight / this.maximumDrawHeight;
        drawHeight = this.maximumDrawHeight;
        scale = true;
    }

    Rectangle2D chartArea = new Rectangle2D.Double(0.0, 0.0, drawWidth,
            drawHeight);

    return new ChartAreaMetrics(insets, available, scale, chartArea);
}

/**
 * Ensures the off-screen buffer exists and is the correct size.
 *
 * @param g2 the graphics device.
 * @param metrics the current chart area metrics.
 */
private void ensureBuffer(Graphics2D g2, ChartAreaMetrics metrics) {
    if ((this.chartBuffer == null)
            || (this.chartBufferWidth != metrics.available.getWidth())
            || (this.chartBufferHeight != metrics.available.getHeight())) {
        this.chartBufferWidth = (int) metrics.available.getWidth();
        this.chartBufferHeight = (int) metrics.available.getHeight();
        GraphicsConfiguration gc = g2.getDeviceConfiguration();
        this.chartBuffer = gc.createCompatibleImage(
                this.chartBufferWidth, this.chartBufferHeight,
                Transparency.TRANSLUCENT);
        this.refreshBuffer = true;
    }
}

private void drawChartToBuffer(ChartAreaMetrics metrics) {
    this.refreshBuffer = false;

    Rectangle2D bufferArea = new Rectangle2D.Double(
            0, 0, this.chartBufferWidth, this.chartBufferHeight);

    Graphics2D bufferG2 = (Graphics2D) this.chartBuffer.getGraphics();
    Composite savedComposite = bufferG2.getComposite();
    bufferG2.setComposite(AlphaComposite.getInstance(
            AlphaComposite.CLEAR, 0.0f));
    Rectangle r = new Rectangle(0, 0, this.chartBufferWidth,
            this.chartBufferHeight);
    bufferG2.fill(r);
    bufferG2.setComposite(savedComposite);

    if (metrics.scale) {
        AffineTransform saved = bufferG2.getTransform();
        AffineTransform st = AffineTransform.getScaleInstance(
                this.scaleX, this.scaleY);
        bufferG2.transform(st);
        this.chart.draw(bufferG2, metrics.chartArea, this.anchor,
                this.info);
        bufferG2.setTransform(saved);
    }
    else {
        this.chart.draw(bufferG2, bufferArea, this.anchor,
                this.info);
    }
    bufferG2.dispose();
}

    if (metrics.scale) {
        AffineTransform st = AffineTransform.getScaleInstance(
                this.scaleX, this.scaleY);
        g2.transform(st);

    this.chart.draw(g2, metrics.chartArea, this.anchor, this.info);

}

@Override
public void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
    super.paintComponent(g);
    if (this.chart == null) {
        return;
    }
    Graphics2D g2 = (Graphics2D) g.create();
    
    // first determine the size of the chart rendering area...
    Dimension size = getSize();
    Insets insets = getInsets();
    Rectangle2D available = new Rectangle2D.Double(insets.left, insets.top,
            size.getWidth() - insets.left - insets.right,
            size.getHeight() - insets.top - insets.bottom);

    // work out if scaling is required...
    boolean scale = false;
    double drawWidth = available.getWidth();
    double drawHeight = available.getHeight();
    this.scaleX = 1.0;
    this.scaleY = 1.0;

    if (drawWidth < this.minimumDrawWidth) {
        this.scaleX = drawWidth / this.minimumDrawWidth;
        drawWidth = this.minimumDrawWidth;
        scale = true;
    }
    else if (drawWidth > this.maximumDrawWidth) {
        this.scaleX = drawWidth / this.maximumDrawWidth;
        drawWidth = this.maximumDrawWidth;
        scale = true;
    }

    if (drawHeight < this.minimumDrawHeight) {
        this.scaleY = drawHeight / this.minimumDrawHeight;
        drawHeight = this.minimumDrawHeight;
        scale = true;
    }
    else if (drawHeight > this.maximumDrawHeight) {
        this.scaleY = drawHeight / this.maximumDrawHeight;
        drawHeight = this.maximumDrawHeight;
        scale = true;
    }

    Rectangle2D chartArea = new Rectangle2D.Double(0.0, 0.0, drawWidth,
            drawHeight);

    // are we using the chart buffer?
    if (this.useBuffer) {

        // do we need to resize the buffer?
        if ((this.chartBuffer == null)
                || (this.chartBufferWidth != available.getWidth())
                || (this.chartBufferHeight != available.getHeight())) {
            this.chartBufferWidth = (int) available.getWidth();
            this.chartBufferHeight = (int) available.getHeight();
            GraphicsConfiguration gc = g2.getDeviceConfiguration();
            this.chartBuffer = gc.createCompatibleImage(
                    this.chartBufferWidth, this.chartBufferHeight,
                    Transparency.TRANSLUCENT);
            this.refreshBuffer = true;
        }

        // do we need to redraw the buffer?
        if (this.refreshBuffer) {

            this.refreshBuffer = false; // clear the flag

            Rectangle2D bufferArea = new Rectangle2D.Double(
                    0, 0, this.chartBufferWidth, this.chartBufferHeight);

            // make the background of the buffer clear and transparent
            Graphics2D bufferG2 = (Graphics2D)
                    this.chartBuffer.getGraphics();
            Composite savedComposite = bufferG2.getComposite();
            bufferG2.setComposite(AlphaComposite.getInstance(
                    AlphaComposite.CLEAR, 0.0f));
            Rectangle r = new Rectangle(0, 0, this.chartBufferWidth,
                    this.chartBufferHeight);
            bufferG2.fill(r);
            bufferG2.setComposite(savedComposite);
            
            if (scale) {
                AffineTransform saved = bufferG2.getTransform();
                AffineTransform st = AffineTransform.getScaleInstance(
                        this.scaleX, this.scaleY);
                bufferG2.transform(st);
                this.chart.draw(bufferG2, chartArea, this.anchor,
                        this.info);
                bufferG2.setTransform(saved);
            } else {
                this.chart.draw(bufferG2, bufferArea, this.anchor,
                        this.info);
            }

        }

        // zap the buffer onto the panel...
        g2.drawImage(this.chartBuffer, insets.left, insets.top, this);

    } else { // redrawing the chart every time...
        AffineTransform saved = g2.getTransform();
        g2.translate(insets.left, insets.top);
        if (scale) {
            AffineTransform st = AffineTransform.getScaleInstance(
                    this.scaleX, this.scaleY);
            g2.transform(st);
        }
        this.chart.draw(g2, chartArea, this.anchor, this.info);
        g2.setTransform(saved);

    }

    Iterator iterator = this.overlays.iterator();
    while (iterator.hasNext()) {
        Overlay overlay = (Overlay) iterator.next();
        overlay.paintOverlay(g2, this);
    }

    // redraw the zoom rectangle (if present) - if useBuffer is false,
    // we use XOR so we can XOR the rectangle away again without redrawing
    // the chart
    drawZoomRectangle(g2, !this.useBuffer);

    g2.dispose();

    this.anchor = null;
    this.verticalTraceLine = null;
    this.horizontalTraceLine = null;
}
```

    private Rectangle2D computeChartArea(Rectangle2D available) {
        double drawWidth = available.getWidth();
        double drawHeight = available.getHeight();
        this.scaleX = 1.0;
        this.scaleY = 1.0;

        if (drawWidth < this.minimumDrawWidth) {
            this.scaleX = drawWidth / this.minimumDrawWidth;
            drawWidth = this.minimumDrawWidth;
        }
        else if (drawWidth > this.maximumDrawWidth) {
            this.scaleX = drawWidth / this.maximumDrawWidth;
            drawWidth = this.maximumDrawWidth;
        }

        if (drawHeight < this.minimumDrawHeight) {
            this.scaleY = drawHeight / this.minimumDrawHeight;
            drawHeight = this.minimumDrawHeight;
        }
        else if (drawHeight > this.maximumDrawHeight) {
            this.scaleY = drawHeight / this.maximumDrawHeight;
            drawHeight = this.maximumDrawHeight;
        }

        return new Rectangle2D.Double(0.0, 0.0, drawWidth, drawHeight);
    }

    private void drawChartToBuffer(Rectangle2D chartArea) {
        if (!this.refreshBuffer) {
            return;
        }
        this.refreshBuffer = false;

        Rectangle2D bufferArea = new Rectangle2D.Double(
                0, 0, this.chartBufferWidth, this.chartBufferHeight);

        Graphics2D bufferG2 = (Graphics2D) this.chartBuffer.getGraphics();
        Composite savedComposite = bufferG2.getComposite();
        bufferG2.setComposite(AlphaComposite.getInstance(

        Rectangle r = new Rectangle(0, 0, this.chartBufferWidth,
                this.chartBufferHeight);
        bufferG2.fill(r);
        bufferG2.setComposite(savedComposite);

            AffineTransform saved = bufferG2.getTransform();
            AffineTransform st = AffineTransform.getScaleInstance(
                    this.scaleX, this.scaleY);
            bufferG2.transform(st);
            this.chart.draw(bufferG2, chartArea, this.anchor, this.info);
            bufferG2.setTransform(saved);
        }
        else {
            this.chart.draw(bufferG2, bufferArea, this.anchor, this.info);
        }
    }

private static class AngleAnchorRange {
    private final double lower;
    private final double upper;
    private final boolean lowerInclusive;
    private final boolean upperInclusive;
    private final TextAnchor anchor;

    AngleAnchorRange(double lower, double upper, boolean lowerInclusive,
            boolean upperInclusive, TextAnchor anchor) {
        this.lower = lower;
        this.upper = upper;
        this.lowerInclusive = lowerInclusive;
        this.upperInclusive = upperInclusive;
        this.anchor = anchor;
    }

    boolean contains(double angle) {
        if (angle < this.lower || angle > this.upper) {
            return false;
        }
        if (angle == this.lower) {
            return this.lowerInclusive;
        }
        if (angle == this.upper) {
            return this.upperInclusive;
        }
        return true;
    }

    TextAnchor getAnchor() {
        return this.anchor;
    }
}

protected TextAnchor calculateTextAnchor(double angleDegrees) {
    double normalizedAngle = normalizeAngle(angleDegrees);
    if (Double.isNaN(normalizedAngle)) {
        return TextAnchor.CENTER;
    }
    for (Iterator it = ANGLE_ANCHOR_RANGES.iterator(); it.hasNext();) {
        AngleAnchorRange range = (AngleAnchorRange) it.next();
        if (range.contains(normalizedAngle)) {
            return range.getAnchor();
        }
    }
    return TextAnchor.CENTER;
}
```

`normalizeAngle`:
```
/**
 * Normalizes the given angle using the current offset and direction settings.
 *
 * @param angleDegrees  the angle in degrees.
 *
 * @return The normalized angle in the range [0, 360).
 */
private double normalizeAngle(double angleDegrees) {
    double offset = this.angleOffset;
    while (offset < 0.0) {
        offset += 360.0;
    }
    double normalizedAngle = (((this.counterClockwise ? -1 : 1) * angleDegrees) + offset) % 360;
    while (this.counterClockwise && (normalizedAngle < 0.0)) {
        normalizedAngle += 360.0;
    }
    return normalizedAngle;
}

protected AxisState drawAxis(ValueAxis axis, PolarAxisLocation location,
        Graphics2D g2, Rectangle2D plotArea) {

private List getDatasetsMappedToAxis(Integer axisIndex) {
    ParamChecks.nullNotPermitted(axisIndex, "axisIndex");
    List result = new ArrayList();
    for (int i = 0; i < this.datasets.size(); i++) {
        List mappedAxes = (List) this.datasetToAxesMap.get(new Integer(i));
        if (mappedAxes == null) {
            if (isPrimaryAxisIndex(axisIndex)) {
                result.add(this.datasets.get(i));
            }
        } else {
            if (mappedAxes.contains(axisIndex)) {
                result.add(this.datasets.get(i));
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}

private static final class AngleAnchorMapping {
    /** The lower bound of the range (in degrees). */
    private final double lowerBound;

    private final double upperBound;
    /** A flag that indicates whether the lower bound is inclusive. */
    private final boolean lowerInclusive;
    /** A flag that indicates whether the upper bound is inclusive. */

        this.upperBound = upperBound;

     * mapping's range.

    boolean matches(double angle) {

            return false;

        if (angle == this.lowerBound && !this.lowerInclusive) {
            return false;
        }
        if (angle == this.upperBound && !this.upperInclusive) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    /**

     * @return The text anchor.
     */
    TextAnchor getAnchor() {

/**
 * A mapping from an angular range to a text anchor.
 */
private static final class AngleAnchorMapping {

    /** The lower bound of the range (in degrees). */
    private final double lowerBound;

    /** A flag that indicates whether the lower bound is inclusive. */
    private final boolean lowerInclusive;

    /** The upper bound of the range (in degrees). */
    private final double upperBound;

    /** A flag that indicates whether the upper bound is inclusive. */
    private final boolean upperInclusive;

    /** The text anchor for this range. */
    private final TextAnchor anchor;

    /**
     * Creates a new mapping.
     *
     * @param lowerBound  the lower bound.
     * @param lowerInclusive  a flag that indicates whether the lower bound
     *                        is inclusive.
     * @param upperBound  the upper bound.
     * @param upperInclusive  a flag that indicates whether the upper bound
     *                        is inclusive.
     * @param anchor  the text anchor.
     */
    AngleAnchorMapping(double lowerBound, boolean lowerInclusive,
            double upperBound, boolean upperInclusive, TextAnchor anchor) {
        this.lowerBound = lowerBound;
        this.lowerInclusive = lowerInclusive;
        this.upperBound = upperBound;
        this.upperInclusive = upperInclusive;
        this.anchor = anchor;
    }

    /**
     * Returns <code>true</code> if the specified angle falls within this
     * mapping's range.
     *
     * @param angle  the normalized angle (in degrees).
     *
     * @return A boolean.
     */
    boolean matches(double angle) {
        if (angle < this.lowerBound || angle > this.upperBound) {
            return false;
        }
        if (angle == this.lowerBound && !this.lowerInclusive) {
            return false;
        }
        if (angle == this.upperBound && !this.upperInclusive) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the text anchor.
     *
     * @return The text anchor.
     */
    TextAnchor getAnchor() {
        return this.anchor;
    }
}

### normalizeAngle

```
/**
 * Normalizes the specified angle using the current offset and direction
 * settings.
 *
 * @param angleDegrees  the angle in degrees.
 *
 * @return The normalized angle in the range 0 to 360 degrees.
 */
private double normalizeAngle(double angleDegrees) {
    double offset = this.angleOffset;
    while (offset < 0.0) {
        offset += 360.0;
    }
    double direction = this.counterClockwise ? -1.0 : 1.0;
    double normalized = (direction * angleDegrees + offset) % 360.0;
    while (this.counterClockwise && normalized < 0.0) {
        normalized += 360.0;
    }
    return normalized;
}
```

### calculateTextAnchor

```
/**
 * Calculate the text position for the given degrees.
 *
 * @param angleDegrees  the angle in degrees.
 * 
 * @return The optimal text anchor.
 * @since 1.0.14
 */
protected TextAnchor calculateTextAnchor(double angleDegrees) {
    double normalizedAngle = normalizeAngle(angleDegrees);
    for (int i = 0; i < ANGLE_ANCHOR_MAPPINGS.length; i++) {
        AngleAnchorMapping mapping = ANGLE_ANCHOR_MAPPINGS[i];
        if (mapping.matches(normalizedAngle)) {
            return mapping.getAnchor();
        }
    }
    return TextAnchor.CENTER;
}

private Rectangle2D createIntervalRect(AxisDrawContext ctx, double low, double high, PlotOrientation orientation) {
    if (orientation == PlotOrientation.HORIZONTAL) {
        low = Math.max(low, ctx.dataArea.getMinY());
        high = Math.min(high, ctx.dataArea.getMaxY());
        return new Rectangle2D.Double(ctx.dataArea.getMinX(), low, ctx.dataArea.getWidth(), high - low);
    }
    else if (orientation == PlotOrientation.VERTICAL) {
        low = Math.max(low, ctx.dataArea.getMinX());
        high = Math.min(high, ctx.dataArea.getMaxX());
        return new Rectangle2D.Double(low, ctx.dataArea.getMinY(), high - low, ctx.dataArea.getHeight());
    }
    return null;
}

private void fillIntervalMarker(Graphics2D g2, IntervalMarker marker, Rectangle2D rect) {

        GradientPaintTransformer t = marker.getGradientPaintTransformer();
        if (t != null) {
            gp = t.transform(gp, rect);
        }
        g2.setPaint(gp);

    }
    g2.fill(rect);
}

private void drawIntervalOutlines(AxisDrawContext ctx, IntervalOutlineContext oc) {
    IntervalMarker im = oc.marker;
    if (im.getOutlinePaint() == null || im.getOutlineStroke() == null) {
        return;
    }
    Range range = ctx.axis.getRange();
    Line2D line = new Line2D.Double();
    ctx.g2.setPaint(im.getOutlinePaint());
    ctx.g2.setStroke(im.getOutlineStroke());
    if (oc.orientation == PlotOrientation.VERTICAL) {
        double y0 = ctx.dataArea.getMinY();
        double y1 = ctx.dataArea.getMaxY();
        if (range.contains(im.getStartValue())) {
            line.setLine(oc.start2d, y0, oc.start2d, y1);
            ctx.g2.draw(line);
        }
        if (range.contains(im.getEndValue())) {
            line.setLine(oc.end2d, y0, oc.end2d, y1);
            ctx.g2.draw(line);
        }
    } else { // HORIZONTAL
        double x0 = ctx.dataArea.getMinX();
        double x1 = ctx.dataArea.getMaxX();
        if (range.contains(im.getStartValue())) {
            line.setLine(x0, oc.start2d, x1, oc.start2d);
            ctx.g2.draw(line);
        }
        if (range.contains(im.getEndValue())) {
            line.setLine(x0, oc.end2d, x1, oc.end2d);
            ctx.g2.draw(line);
        }
    }
}

private void drawIntervalRangeMarker(AxisDrawContext ctx, IntervalMarker marker) {
    double start = marker.getStartValue();
    double end = marker.getEndValue();
    Range range = ctx.axis.getRange();
    if (!range.intersects(start, end)) {
        return;
    }
    double start2d = ctx.axis.valueToJava2D(start, ctx.dataArea, ctx.plot.getRangeAxisEdge());
    double end2d = ctx.axis.valueToJava2D(end, ctx.dataArea, ctx.plot.getRangeAxisEdge());
    double low = Math.min(start2d, end2d);
    double high = Math.max(start2d, end2d);
    PlotOrientation orientation = ctx.plot.getOrientation();
    Rectangle2D rect = createRangeIntervalRect(ctx, low, high, orientation);
    if (rect == null) {
        return;
    }
    final Composite originalComposite = ctx.g2.getComposite();
    ctx.g2.setComposite(AlphaComposite.getInstance(AlphaComposite.SRC_OVER, marker.getAlpha()));
    fillIntervalMarker(ctx.g2, marker, rect);
    drawRangeIntervalOutlines(ctx, new IntervalOutlineContext(marker, start2d, end2d, orientation));
    drawRangeMarkerLabel(ctx, rect, marker, marker.getLabelOffsetType());
    ctx.g2.setComposite(originalComposite);
}

private Rectangle2D createRangeIntervalRect(AxisDrawContext ctx, double low, double high, PlotOrientation orientation) {
    if (orientation == PlotOrientation.HORIZONTAL) {
        low = Math.max(low, ctx.dataArea.getMinX());
        high = Math.min(high, ctx.dataArea.getMaxX());
        return new Rectangle2D.Double(low, ctx.dataArea.getMinY(), high - low, ctx.dataArea.getHeight());
    }
    else if (orientation == PlotOrientation.VERTICAL) {
        low = Math.max(low, ctx.dataArea.getMinY());
        high = Math.min(high, ctx.dataArea.getMaxY());
        return new Rectangle2D.Double(ctx.dataArea.getMinX(), low, ctx.dataArea.getWidth(), high - low);
    }
    return null;
}

private void drawRangeIntervalOutlines(AxisDrawContext ctx, IntervalOutlineContext oc) {
    IntervalMarker im = oc.marker;
    if (im.getOutlinePaint() == null || im.getOutlineStroke() == null) {
        return;
    }
    Range range = ctx.axis.getRange();
    Line2D line = new Line2D.Double();
    ctx.g2.setPaint(im.getOutlinePaint());
    ctx.g2.setStroke(im.getOutlineStroke());
    if (oc.orientation == PlotOrientation.VERTICAL) {
        double x0 = ctx.dataArea.getMinX();
        double x1 = ctx.dataArea.getMaxX();
        if (range.contains(im.getStartValue())) {
            line.setLine(x0, oc.start2d, x1, oc.start2d);
            ctx.g2.draw(line);
        }
        if (range.contains(im.getEndValue())) {
            line.setLine(x0, oc.end2d, x1, oc.end2d);
            ctx.g2.draw(line);
        }
    } else {
        double y0 = ctx.dataArea.getMinY();
        double y1 = ctx.dataArea.getMaxY();
        if (range.contains(im.getStartValue())) {
            line.setLine(oc.start2d, y0, oc.start2d, y1);
            ctx.g2.draw(line);
        }
        if (range.contains(im.getEndValue())) {
            line.setLine(oc.end2d, y0, oc.end2d, y1);
            ctx.g2.draw(line);
        }
    }
}

private void drawAnnotations(AnnotationRenderContext ctx, AxisPair axes, Layer layer) {
    Iterator iterator = null;
    if (layer.equals(Layer.FOREGROUND)) {
        iterator = this.foregroundAnnotations.iterator();
    }
    else if (layer.equals(Layer.BACKGROUND)) {
        iterator = this.backgroundAnnotations.iterator();
    }
    else {
        throw new RuntimeException("Unknown layer.");
    }
    while (iterator.hasNext()) {
        XYAnnotation annotation = (XYAnnotation) iterator.next();
        int index = this.plot.getIndexOf(this);
        annotation.draw(ctx.g2, this.plot, ctx.dataArea, axes.domainAxis, axes.rangeAxis, index, ctx.info);
    }
}

private void addEntity(EntityCollection entities, EntityTarget target, EntityLocation location) {
    if (!getItemCreateEntity(target.series, target.item)) {
        return;
    }
    Shape hotspot = location.area;
    if (hotspot == null) {
        double r = getDefaultEntityRadius();
        double w = r * 2;
        if (getPlot().getOrientation() == PlotOrientation.VERTICAL) {
            hotspot = new Ellipse2D.Double(location.entityX - r, location.entityY - r, w, w);
        }
        else {
            hotspot = new Ellipse2D.Double(location.entityY - r, location.entityX - r, w, w);
        }
    }
    String tip = null;
    XYToolTipGenerator generator = getToolTipGenerator(target.series, target.item);
    if (generator != null) {
        tip = generator.generateToolTip(target.dataset, target.series, target.item);
    }
    String url = null;
    if (getURLGenerator() != null) {
        url = getURLGenerator().generateURL(target.dataset, target.series, target.item);
    }
    XYItemEntity entity = new XYItemEntity(hotspot, target.dataset, target.series, target.item, tip, url);
    entities.add(entity);
}

            }
        }
    }
}

private DataAreaLayout calculateDataAreaLayout(PlotDrawContext ctx) {
    Rectangle2D area = (Rectangle2D) ctx.getArea().clone();
    getInsets().trim(area);
    AxisSpace space = new AxisSpace();
    space = this.domainAxis.reserveSpace(ctx.getG2(), this, area,
            RectangleEdge.BOTTOM, space);
    space = this.rangeAxis.reserveSpace(ctx.getG2(), this, area,
            RectangleEdge.LEFT, space);
    Rectangle2D estimatedDataArea = space.shrink(area, null);
    AxisSpace space2 = new AxisSpace();
    space2 = this.colorBar.reserveSpace(ctx.getG2(), this, area,
            estimatedDataArea, this.colorBarLocation, space2);
    Rectangle2D adjustedPlotArea = space2.shrink(area, null);
    Rectangle2D dataArea = space.shrink(adjustedPlotArea, null);
    Rectangle2D colorBarArea = space2.reserved(area, this.colorBarLocation);
    dataArea = applyDataAreaRatio(dataArea);
    if (ctx.getInfo() != null) {
        ctx.getInfo().setDataArea(dataArea);
    }
    return new DataAreaLayout(dataArea, adjustedPlotArea, colorBarArea);
}

```
private Rectangle2D applyDataAreaRatio(Rectangle2D dataArea) {
    double ratio = getDataAreaRatio();
    if (ratio == 0.0) {
        return dataArea;
    }
    Rectangle2D tmpDataArea = (Rectangle2D) dataArea.clone();
    double h = tmpDataArea.getHeight();
    double w = tmpDataArea.getWidth();
    if (ratio > 0) {
        if (w * ratio <= h) {
            h = ratio * w;
        } else {
            w = h / ratio;
        }
    } else {
        ratio *= -1.0;
        double xLength = getDomainAxis().getRange().getLength();
        double yLength = getRangeAxis().getRange().getLength();
        double unitRatio = yLength / xLength;
        ratio = unitRatio * ratio;
        if (w * ratio <= h) {
            h = ratio * w;
        } else {
            w = h / ratio;
        }
    }
    dataArea.setRect(tmpDataArea.getX() + tmpDataArea.getWidth() / 2.0 - w / 2.0,
            tmpDataArea.getY(), w, h);
    return dataArea;
}
```

        entities = ctx.getInfo().getOwner().getEntityCollection();
    }
    Object antiAlias = ctx.getG2().getRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING);
    ctx.getG2().setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING,
            RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_OFF);

    ContourDataset data = rdata.getData();
    Number[] xNumber = data.getXValues();
    Number[] yNumber = data.getYValues();
    Number[] zNumber = data.getZValues();
    double[] x = new double[xNumber.length];
    double[] y = new double[yNumber.length];
    for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
        x[i] = xNumber[i].doubleValue();
        y[i] = yNumber[i].doubleValue();
    }
    int[] xIndex = data.indexX();
    int[] indexX = data.getXIndices();
    boolean vertInverted = ((NumberAxis) rdata.getRangeAxis()).isInverted();
    boolean horizInverted = false;
    if (rdata.getDomainAxis() instanceof NumberAxis) {
        horizInverted = ((NumberAxis) rdata.getDomainAxis()).isInverted();
    }

    HorizontalTransformContext hctx = new HorizontalTransformContext(
            rdata.getDomainAxis(), ctx.getDataArea(), x, indexX,
            xIndex[xIndex.length - 1], horizInverted);
    VerticalTransformContext vctx = new VerticalTransformContext(
            rdata.getRangeAxis(), ctx.getDataArea(), y, vertInverted);

    EntityContext entityCtx = new EntityContext(entities, data,
            getToolTipGenerator());
    ContourPaintSource paintSource = new ContourPaintSource(rdata.getColorBar(),
            this.missingPaint);
    ContourItemState state = new ContourItemState();
    state.setRect(new Rectangle2D.Double());

    for (int k = 0; k < x.length; k++) {
        state.setI(xIndex[k]);
        state.setNewColumn(indexX[state.getI()] == k);
        state.setEndColumn((state.getI() < indexX.length - 1
                && indexX[state.getI() + 1] - 1 == k) || k == x.length - 1);
        if (state.isNewColumn()) {
            computeHorizontalTransform(hctx, state, k);
        }
        computeVerticalTransform(vctx, state, k);
        state.setTransDY(state.getTransDYm1() + state.getTransDYp1());
        state.getRect().setRect(state.getTransX(), state.getTransY(),
                state.getTransDX(), state.getTransDY());
        fillContourRect(ctx.getG2(), state.getRect(), zNumber[k], paintSource);
        addContourEntity(entityCtx, k, state.getRect());
        updateCrosshairs(new CrosshairUpdate(x[k], y[k], state.getTransX(),
                state.getTransY()), ctx.getCrosshairState(), rdata.getPlot());
    }

    ctx.getG2().setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, antiAlias);
}

private void computeHorizontalTransform(HorizontalTransformContext hctx,
                                        ContourItemState state, int k) throws CloneNotSupportedException {
    double transX;
    double transXm1;
    double transXp1;
    double transDXm1;
    double transDXp1;
    int i = state.getI();
    int iMax = hctx.getIMax();
    ValueAxis horizontalAxis = hctx.getAxis();
    Rectangle2D dataArea = hctx.getDataArea();
    double[] x = hctx.getX();
    int[] indexX = hctx.getIndexX();
    if (i == 0) {
        transX = horizontalAxis.valueToJava2D(x[k], dataArea,
                RectangleEdge.BOTTOM);
        transXm1 = transX;
        transXp1 = horizontalAxis.valueToJava2D(x[indexX[i + 1]], dataArea,
                RectangleEdge.BOTTOM);
        transDXm1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transX - transXm1));
        transDXp1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transX - transXp1));
    } else if (i == iMax) {
        transX = horizontalAxis.valueToJava2D(x[k], dataArea,
                RectangleEdge.BOTTOM);
        transXm1 = horizontalAxis.valueToJava2D(x[indexX[i - 1]], dataArea,
                RectangleEdge.BOTTOM);
        transXp1 = transX;
        transDXm1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transX - transXm1));
        transDXp1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transX - transXp1));
    } else {
        transX = horizontalAxis.valueToJava2D(x[k], dataArea,
                RectangleEdge.BOTTOM);
        transXp1 = horizontalAxis.valueToJava2D(x[indexX[i + 1]], dataArea,
                RectangleEdge.BOTTOM);
        transDXm1 = state.getTransDXp1();
        transDXp1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transX - transXp1));
    }
    if (hctx.isHorizInverted()) {
        transX -= transDXp1;
    } else {
        transX -= transDXm1;
    }
    state.setTransX(transX);
    state.setTransDX(transDXm1 + transDXp1);
    state.setTransDXm1(transDXm1);
    state.setTransDXp1(transDXp1);
}

        transXp1 = input.domainAxis.valueToJava2D(state.x[state.indexX[i + 1]],

        transDXm1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transX - transXm1));

                input.dataArea, RectangleEdge.BOTTOM);
        transDXm1 = state.lastTransDXp1;
        transDXp1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transX - transXp1));
    }
    state.lastTransDXp1 = transDXp1;
    double drawX = state.horizInverted ? transX - transDXp1 : transX - transDXm1;
    double transDX = transDXm1 + transDXp1;

private HorizontalPosition calculateHorizontalPosition(RendererInput input,
        ContourRenderState state, int k) {
    int i = state.xIndex[k];
    if (state.indexX[i] != k) {
        return state.horizontalPosition;
    }
    double transX = input.getDomainAxis().valueToJava2D(state.x[k],
            input.getDataArea(), RectangleEdge.BOTTOM);
    double transDXm1;
    double transDXp1;
    if (i == 0) {
        double transXp1 = input.getDomainAxis().valueToJava2D(
                state.x[state.indexX[i + 1]], input.getDataArea(),
                RectangleEdge.BOTTOM);
        transDXm1 = 0.0;
        transDXp1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transX - transXp1));
    } else if (i == state.iMax) {
        double transXm1 = input.getDomainAxis().valueToJava2D(
                state.x[state.indexX[i - 1]], input.getDataArea(),
                RectangleEdge.BOTTOM);
        transDXm1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transX - transXm1));
        transDXp1 = 0.0;
    } else {
        double transXp1 = input.getDomainAxis().valueToJava2D(
                state.x[state.indexX[i + 1]], input.getDataArea(),
                RectangleEdge.BOTTOM);
        transDXm1 = state.lastTransDXp1;
        transDXp1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transX - transXp1));
    }
    state.lastTransDXp1 = transDXp1;
    double drawX = state.horizInverted ? transX - transDXp1 : transX - transDXm1;
    double transDX = transDXm1 + transDXp1;
    state.horizontalPosition = new HorizontalPosition(drawX, transDX);
    return state.horizontalPosition;
}
```
3 params. Complexity: if not new column (1), if i==0 (1), else if iMax (1), else (1) = 4. Good.

private VerticalPosition calculateVerticalPosition(RendererInput input,
        ContourRenderState state, int k) {
    int i = state.xIndex[k];
    boolean newColumn = (state.indexX[i] == k);
    boolean endOfColumn = (i < state.indexX.length - 1
            && state.indexX[i + 1] - 1 == k) || k == state.x.length - 1;
    double transY;
    double transDYm1;
    double transDYp1;
    if (newColumn) {
        transY = input.getRangeAxis().valueToJava2D(state.y[k],
                input.getDataArea(), RectangleEdge.LEFT);
        if (k + 1 == state.y.length) {
            return null;
        }
        double transYp1 = input.getRangeAxis().valueToJava2D(state.y[k + 1],
                input.getDataArea(), RectangleEdge.LEFT);
        transDYm1 = 0.0;
        transDYp1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transY - transYp1));
    } else if (endOfColumn) {
        transY = input.getRangeAxis().valueToJava2D(state.y[k],
                input.getDataArea(), RectangleEdge.LEFT);
        double transYm1 = input.getRangeAxis().valueToJava2D(state.y[k - 1],
                input.getDataArea(), RectangleEdge.LEFT);
        transDYm1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transY - transYm1));
        transDYp1 = 0.0;
    } else {
        transY = input.getRangeAxis().valueToJava2D(state.y[k],
                input.getDataArea(), RectangleEdge.LEFT);
        double transYp1 = input.getRangeAxis().valueToJava2D(state.y[k + 1],
                input.getDataArea(), RectangleEdge.LEFT);
        transDYm1 = state.lastTransDYp1;
        transDYp1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transY - transYp1));
    }
    state.lastTransDYp1 = transDYp1;
    double drawY = state.vertInverted ? transY - transDYm1 : transY - transDYp1;
    double transDY = transDYm1 + transDYp1;
    return new VerticalPosition(drawY, transDY);
}
```

    public void contourRenderer(RendererInput input) {
        EntityCollection entities = null;
        if (input.getInfo() != null) {
            entities = input.getInfo().getOwner().getEntityCollection();
        }

        Graphics2D g2 = input.getGraphics2D();
        Object antiAlias = g2.getRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING);
        g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING,
                RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_OFF);

        ContourRenderState state = createContourRenderState(input, entities);

        for (int k = 0; k < state.x.length; k++) {
            renderContourItem(input, state, k);
        }

        g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, antiAlias);
    }

        input.getGraphics2D().draw(line);

    /**
     * Draws a vertical line on the chart to represent a 'range marker'.
     *
     * @param input  the marker input (not <code>null</code>).
     */
    public void drawDomainMarker(MarkerDrawInput input) {
        Marker marker = input.getMarker();
        if (marker instanceof ValueMarker) {
            ValueMarker vm = (ValueMarker) marker;
            double value = vm.getValue();
            ValueAxis axis = input.getAxis();
            Range range = axis.getRange();
            if (!range.contains(value)) {
                return;
            }

            double x = axis.valueToJava2D(value, input.getDataArea(),
                    RectangleEdge.BOTTOM);
            Line2D line = new Line2D.Double(x, input.getDataArea().getMinY(),
                    x, input.getDataArea().getMaxY());
            Paint paint = marker.getOutlinePaint();
            Stroke stroke = marker.getOutlineStroke();
            Graphics2D g2 = input.getGraphics2D();
            g2.setPaint(paint != null ? paint : Plot.DEFAULT_OUTLINE_PAINT);
            g2.setStroke(stroke != null ? stroke : Plot.DEFAULT_OUTLINE_STROKE);
            g2.draw(line);
        }
    }

private void adjustDataAreaForRatio(Rectangle2D dataArea) {
    double ratio = getDataAreaRatio();
    Rectangle2D tmpDataArea = (Rectangle2D) dataArea.clone();
    double h = tmpDataArea.getHeight();
    double w = tmpDataArea.getWidth();

    if (ratio > 0) {
        if (w * ratio <= h) {
            h = ratio * w;
        } else {
            w = h / ratio;
        }
    } else {
        ratio *= -1.0;
        double xLength = getDomainAxis().getRange().getLength();
        double yLength = getRangeAxis().getRange().getLength();
        double unitRatio = yLength / xLength;
        ratio = unitRatio * ratio;
        if (w * ratio <= h) {
            h = ratio * w;
        } else {
            w = h / ratio;
        }
    }

    dataArea.setRect(tmpDataArea.getX() + tmpDataArea.getWidth() / 2.0
            - w / 2.0, tmpDataArea.getY(), w, h);
}

private void updateHorizontalGeometry(CellState state, int k, int i,
                                      GeometryContext context) {
    if (context.indexX[i] != k) {
        return;
    }

    double transX = context.horizontalAxis.valueToJava2D(context.x[k],
            context.dataArea, RectangleEdge.BOTTOM);
    double transDXm1;
    double transDXp1;

    if (i == 0) {

                context.x[context.indexX[i + 1]], context.dataArea,
                RectangleEdge.BOTTOM);
        transDXm1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transX - transX));
        transDXp1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transX - transXp1));
    } else if (i == context.iMax) {
        double transXm1 = context.horizontalAxis.valueToJava2D(
                context.x[context.indexX[i - 1]], context.dataArea,
                RectangleEdge.BOTTOM);
        transDXm1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transX - transXm1));
        transDXp1 = Math.abs(0.5 * (transX - transX));

        transX -= transDXm1;

    state.transDX = transDXm1 + transDXp1;

protected List refreshTicksHorizontal(Graphics2D g2, Rectangle2D dataArea,
            RectangleEdge edge) {

    List result = new java.util.ArrayList();

    prepareTickLabelFont(g2);
    selectTickUnitIfNecessary(g2, dataArea, edge);

    DateTickUnit unit = getTickUnit();
    Date tickDate = calculateLowestVisibleTickValue(unit);
    Date upperDate = getMaximumDate();

    boolean hasRolled = false;
    while (tickDate.before(upperDate)) {
        tickDate = applyTickMarkPosition(tickDate, unit, hasRolled);
        int minorTickSpaces = calculateMinorTickSpaces(unit);
        addLeadingMinorTicks(result, tickDate, unit, minorTickSpaces);

        if (isHiddenValue(tickDate.getTime())) {
            tickDate = unit.rollDate(tickDate, this.timeZone);
            hasRolled = true;
        }
        else {
            result.add(createHorizontalMajorTick(tickDate, edge));
            hasRolled = false;
            long currentTickTime = tickDate.getTime();
            tickDate = unit.addToDate(tickDate, this.timeZone);
            addTrailingMinorTicks(result, currentTickTime, tickDate.getTime(),
                    minorTickSpaces);
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

`addLeadingMinorTicks`:
```
private void addLeadingMinorTicks(List result, Date tickDate,
        DateTickUnit unit, int minorTickSpaces) {
    long lowestTickTime = tickDate.getTime();
    long nextTickTime = unit.addToDate(tickDate, this.timeZone).getTime();
    long distance = nextTickTime - lowestTickTime;
    for (int minorTick = 1; minorTick < minorTickSpaces; minorTick++) {
        long minorTickTime = lowestTickTime - distance * minorTick
                / minorTickSpaces;
        if (minorTickTime > 0 && getRange().contains(minorTickTime)
                && !isHiddenValue(minorTickTime)) {
            result.add(new DateTick(TickType.MINOR, new Date(minorTickTime),
                    "", TextAnchor.TOP_CENTER, TextAnchor.CENTER, 0.0));
        }
    }
}
```

`addTrailingMinorTicks`:
```
private void addTrailingMinorTicks(List result, long currentTickTime,
        long nextTickTime, int minorTickSpaces) {
    for (int minorTick = 1; minorTick < minorTickSpaces; minorTick++) {
        long minorTickTime = currentTickTime
                + (nextTickTime - currentTickTime) * minorTick
                / minorTickSpaces;
        if (getRange().contains(minorTickTime)
                && !isHiddenValue(minorTickTime)) {
            result.add(new DateTick(TickType.MINOR, new Date(minorTickTime),
                    "", TextAnchor.TOP_CENTER, TextAnchor.CENTER, 0.0));
        }
    }
}

private DateTick createHorizontalMajorTick(Date tickDate, RectangleEdge edge) {
    String tickLabel = formatTickLabel(tickDate);
    TextAnchor anchor;
    TextAnchor rotationAnchor;
    double angle = 0.0;
    if (isVerticalTickLabels()) {
        anchor = TextAnchor.CENTER_RIGHT;
        rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.CENTER_RIGHT;
        if (edge == RectangleEdge.TOP) {
            angle = Math.PI / 2.0;
        }
        else {
            angle = -Math.PI / 2.0;
        }
    }
    else {
        if (edge == RectangleEdge.TOP) {
            anchor = TextAnchor.BOTTOM_CENTER;
            rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.BOTTOM_CENTER;
        }
        else {
            anchor = TextAnchor.TOP_CENTER;
            rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.TOP_CENTER;
        }
    }
    return new DateTick(tickDate, tickLabel, anchor, rotationAnchor, angle);
}

protected Date previousStandardDate(Date date, DateTickUnit unit) {
    Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance(this.timeZone, this.locale);
    calendar.setTime(date);
    int count = unit.getCount();
    int current = calendar.get(unit.getCalendarField());
    int value = count * (current / count);
    return previousStandardDateForUnit(date, unit, calendar, value);
}

private Date previousStandardDateForUnit(Date date, DateTickUnit unit,
        Calendar calendar, int value) {
    switch (unit.getUnit()) {
        case DateTickUnit.MILLISECOND:
            return previousStandardMillisecond(date, calendar, value);
        case DateTickUnit.SECOND:
            return previousStandardSecond(date, calendar, value);
        case DateTickUnit.MINUTE:
            return previousStandardMinute(date, calendar, value);
        case DateTickUnit.HOUR:
            return previousStandardHour(date, calendar, value);
        case DateTickUnit.DAY:
            return previousStandardDay(date, calendar, value);
        case DateTickUnit.MONTH:
            return previousStandardMonth(date, calendar, value);
        case DateTickUnit.YEAR:
            return previousStandardYear(date, calendar, value);
        default:
            return null;
    }
}

private Date previousStandardMillisecond(Date date, Calendar calendar, int value) {
    int years = calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR);
    int months = calendar.get(Calendar.MONTH);
    int days = calendar.get(Calendar.DATE);
    int hours = calendar.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY);

    int seconds = calendar.get(Calendar.SECOND);
    calendar.set(years, months, days, hours, minutes, seconds);
    calendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, value);
    Date result = calendar.getTime();
    if (result.getTime() >= date.getTime()) {
        calendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, value - 1);
        result = calendar.getTime();
    }
    return result;
}

private Tick createMajorTick(Date tickDate, RectangleEdge edge) {
    String tickLabel = formatTickDate(tickDate);
    TextAnchor anchor;
    TextAnchor rotationAnchor;
    double angle = 0.0;
    if (RectangleEdge.isTopOrBottom(edge)) {
        if (isVerticalTickLabels()) {
            anchor = TextAnchor.CENTER_RIGHT;
            rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.CENTER_RIGHT;
            angle = (edge == RectangleEdge.TOP) ? Math.PI / 2.0 : -Math.PI / 2.0;
        } else {
            if (edge == RectangleEdge.TOP) {
                anchor = TextAnchor.BOTTOM_CENTER;
                rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.BOTTOM_CENTER;
            } else {
                anchor = TextAnchor.TOP_CENTER;
                rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.TOP_CENTER;
            }
        }
    } else { // left or right
        if (isVerticalTickLabels()) {
            anchor = TextAnchor.BOTTOM_CENTER;
            rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.BOTTOM_CENTER;
            angle = (edge == RectangleEdge.LEFT) ? -Math.PI / 2.0 : Math.PI / 2.0;
        } else {
            if (edge == RectangleEdge.LEFT) {
                anchor = TextAnchor.CENTER_RIGHT;
                rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.CENTER_RIGHT;
            } else {
                anchor = TextAnchor.CENTER_LEFT;
                rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.CENTER_LEFT;
            }
        }
    }
    return new DateTick(tickDate, tickLabel, anchor, rotationAnchor, angle);
}

/**
 * Creates a copy of the given axis.
 *
 * @param axis  the axis to copy (<code>null</code> not permitted).
 *
 * @since 1.0.19
 */
public DateAxis(DateAxis axis) {
    this(axis.getLabel(), axis.getTimeZone(), axis.getLocale());
    copyFieldsFrom(axis);
    if (axis.dateFormatOverride != null) {
        this.dateFormatOverride = (DateFormat) axis.dateFormatOverride.clone();
    }
}

private void copyFieldsFrom(DateAxis source) {
    Class clazz = source.getClass();
    while (clazz != null) {
        java.lang.reflect.Field[] fields = clazz.getDeclaredFields();
        for (int i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) {
            java.lang.reflect.Field field = fields[i];
            if (java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(field.getModifiers())) {
                continue;
            }
            field.setAccessible(true);
            try {
                field.set(this, field.get(source));
            } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
                // ignore fields that cannot be copied
            }
        }
        clazz = clazz.getSuperclass();
    }
}

protected Date previousStandardDate(Date date, DateTickUnit unit) {
    Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance(this.timeZone, this.locale);
    calendar.setTime(date);

    if (strategy != null) {
        return strategy.previousStandardDate(this, calendar, date, unit, value);
    }
    return null;
}

private static class MillisecondPreviousStandardDateStrategy implements PreviousStandardDateStrategy {
    public Date previousStandardDate(DateAxis axis, Calendar calendar, Date date, DateTickUnit unit, int value) {
        int years = calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR);
        int months = calendar.get(Calendar.MONTH);
        int days = calendar.get(Calendar.DATE);

        if (result.getTime() >= date.getTime()) {
            calendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, value - 1);

}

private DateTick createMajorTick(Date tickDate, String tickLabel, RectangleEdge edge, boolean horizontal) {
    TextAnchor anchor;
    TextAnchor rotationAnchor;
    double angle = 0.0;
    if (isVerticalTickLabels()) {
        anchor = getVerticalAnchor(edge, horizontal);
        rotationAnchor = anchor;
        angle = getVerticalAngle(edge, horizontal);

        rotationAnchor = anchor;

}

private TextAnchor getVerticalAnchor(RectangleEdge edge, boolean horizontal) {
    if (horizontal) {
        return TextAnchor.CENTER_RIGHT;
    }
    return TextAnchor.BOTTOM_CENTER;
}
private double getVerticalAngle(RectangleEdge edge, boolean horizontal) {
    if (horizontal) {
        return (edge == RectangleEdge.TOP) ? Math.PI / 2.0 : -Math.PI / 2.0;
    }
    return (edge == RectangleEdge.LEFT) ? -Math.PI / 2.0 : Math.PI / 2.0;
}
private TextAnchor getHorizontalAnchor(RectangleEdge edge, boolean horizontal) {
    if (horizontal) {
        return (edge == RectangleEdge.TOP) ? TextAnchor.BOTTOM_CENTER : TextAnchor.TOP_CENTER;
    }
    return (edge == RectangleEdge.LEFT) ? TextAnchor.CENTER_RIGHT : TextAnchor.CENTER_LEFT;
}
```

private double estimateMaximumTickLabelSpan(Graphics2D g2, DateTickUnit unit, boolean forWidth) {
    RectangleInsets insets = getTickLabelInsets();
    double result = forWidth ? insets.getLeft() + insets.getRight() : insets.getTop() + insets.getBottom();
    Font tickLabelFont = getTickLabelFont();
    FontRenderContext frc = g2.getFontRenderContext();
    LineMetrics lm = tickLabelFont.getLineMetrics("ABCxyz", frc);
    boolean vertical = isVerticalTickLabels();
    if (forWidth == vertical) {
        result += lm.getHeight();
    } else {
        DateRange range = (DateRange) getRange();
        Date lower = range.getLowerDate();
        Date upper = range.getUpperDate();
        String lowerStr, upperStr;
        DateFormat formatter = getDateFormatOverride();
        if (formatter != null) {
            lowerStr = formatter.format(lower);
            upperStr = formatter.format(upper);
        } else {
            lowerStr = unit.dateToString(lower);
            upperStr = unit.dateToString(upper);
        }
        FontMetrics fm = g2.getFontMetrics(tickLabelFont);
        double w1 = fm.stringWidth(lowerStr);
        double w2 = fm.stringWidth(upperStr);
        result += Math.max(w1, w2);
    }
    return result;
}

private static class MillisecondPreviousStandardDateStrategy
        implements PreviousStandardDateStrategy {
    @Override
    public Date previousStandardDate(DateAxis axis, Calendar calendar,
            Date date, DateTickUnit unit, int value) {
        int years = calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR);
        int months = calendar.get(Calendar.MONTH);
        int days = calendar.get(Calendar.DATE);
        int hours = calendar.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY);
        int minutes = calendar.get(Calendar.MINUTE);
        int seconds = calendar.get(Calendar.SECOND);
        calendar.set(years, months, days, hours, minutes, seconds);
        calendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, value);
        Date result = calendar.getTime();
        if (result.getTime() >= date.getTime()) {
            calendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, value - 1);
            result = calendar.getTime();
        }
        return result;
    }
}

private static abstract class CalendarFieldStrategy
        implements PreviousStandardDateStrategy {
    private final int calendarField;
    CalendarFieldStrategy(int calendarField) { this.calendarField = calendarField; }
    @Override
    public Date previousStandardDate(Date date, DateTickUnit unit,
            DateTickMarkPosition position, TimeZone timeZone, Locale locale) {
        Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance(timeZone, locale);
        calendar.setTime(date);
        int count = unit.getCount();
        int current = calendar.get(this.calendarField);
        int value = count * (current / count);
        setCalendarFields(calendar, value, position);
        Date result = calendar.getTime();
        if (result.getTime() >= date.getTime()) {
            calendar.set(this.calendarField, value - 1);
            result = calendar.getTime();
        }
        return result;
    }
    protected abstract void setCalendarFields(Calendar calendar, int value,
            DateTickMarkPosition position);
}

public double valueToJava2D(double value, double axisMin, double axisMax,
        Rectangle2D area, boolean inverted) {
    double min = area.getX();
    double max = area.getMaxX();
    double fraction = (value - axisMin) / (axisMax - axisMin);
    if (inverted) {
        return max + fraction * (min - max);
    }
    return min + fraction * (max - min);
}

public double java2DToValue(double java2DValue, double axisMin, double axisMax,
        Rectangle2D area, boolean inverted) {
    double min = area.getX();
    double max = area.getMaxX();
    double fraction = (java2DValue - min) / (max - min);
    if (inverted) {
        return axisMax - fraction * (axisMax - axisMin);
    }
    return axisMin + fraction * (axisMax - axisMin);
}

    if (inverted) {

}

        Rectangle2D area, boolean inverted) {

    if (inverted) {
        return axisMax - fraction * (axisMax - axisMin);
    }
    return axisMin + fraction * (axisMax - axisMin);

    /**
     * Base strategy for calendar-field based tick units.
     */
    private static abstract class CalendarFieldStrategy
            implements PreviousStandardDateStrategy {

        /** The calendar field to align. */
        private final int calendarField;

        /**
         * Creates a strategy for the specified calendar field.
         *
         * @param calendarField  the calendar field.
         */
        CalendarFieldStrategy(int calendarField) {
            this.calendarField = calendarField;
        }

        @Override
        public Date previousStandardDate(Date date, DateTickUnit unit,
                DateTickMarkPosition position, TimeZone timeZone,
                Locale locale) {
            Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance(timeZone, locale);
            calendar.setTime(date);
            int count = unit.getCount();
            int current = calendar.get(this.calendarField);
            int value = count * (current / count);
            setSmallerFields(calendar, position);
            calendar.set(this.calendarField, value);
            Date result = calendar.getTime();
            if (result.getTime() >= date.getTime()) {
                calendar.set(this.calendarField, value - 1);
                result = calendar.getTime();
            }
            return result;
        }

        /**
         * Sets the calendar fields smaller than the aligned field.
         *
         * @param calendar  the calendar.
         * @param position  the tick mark position.
         */
        protected abstract void setSmallerFields(Calendar calendar,
                DateTickMarkPosition position);
    }

    private static class MonthStrategy implements PreviousStandardDateStrategy {
        @Override
        public Date previousStandardDate(Date date, DateTickUnit unit,
                DateTickMarkPosition position, TimeZone timeZone,

            Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance(timeZone, locale);

    /**
     * Strategy for converting between data values and Java2D coordinates.
     */
    private interface Java2DConversionStrategy {
        /**
         * Converts a value to a Java2D coordinate.
         *
         * @param value  the data value.
         * @param axisMin  the minimum axis value.
         * @param axisMax  the maximum axis value.
         * @param area  the data area.
         * @param inverted  a flag indicating whether the axis is inverted.
         *
         * @return The Java2D coordinate.
         */
        double valueToJava2D(double value, double axisMin, double axisMax,
                Rectangle2D area, boolean inverted);

        /**
         * Converts a Java2D coordinate to a data value.
         *
         * @param java2DValue  the Java2D coordinate.
         * @param axisMin  the minimum axis value.
         * @param axisMax  the maximum axis value.
         * @param area  the data area.
         * @param inverted  a flag indicating whether the axis is inverted.
         *
         * @return The data value.
         */
        double java2DToValue(double java2DValue, double axisMin, double axisMax,
                Rectangle2D area, boolean inverted);
    }

    /**
     * Horizontal (top or bottom axis) conversion strategy.
     */
    private static class HorizontalJava2DStrategy
            implements Java2DConversionStrategy {
        @Override
        public double valueToJava2D(double value, double axisMin, double axisMax,
                Rectangle2D area, boolean inverted) {
            double min = area.getX();
            double max = area.getMaxX();
            double fraction = (value - axisMin) / (axisMax - axisMin);
            if (inverted) {
                return max + fraction * (min - max);
            }
            return min + fraction * (max - min);
        }
        @Override
        public double java2DToValue(double java2DValue, double axisMin,
                double axisMax, Rectangle2D area, boolean inverted) {
            double min = area.getX();
            double max = area.getMaxX();
            double fraction = (java2DValue - min) / (max - min);
            if (inverted) {
                return axisMax - fraction * (axisMax - axisMin);
            }
            return axisMin + fraction * (axisMax - axisMin);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Vertical (left or right axis) conversion strategy.
     */
    private static class VerticalJava2DStrategy
            implements Java2DConversionStrategy {
        @Override
        public double valueToJava2D(double value, double axisMin, double axisMax,
                Rectangle2D area, boolean inverted) {
            double min = area.getMinY();
            double max = area.getMaxY();
            double fraction = (value - axisMin) / (axisMax - axisMin);
            if (inverted) {
                return min + fraction * (max - min);
            }
            return max - fraction * (max - min);
        }
        @Override
        public double java2DToValue(double java2DValue, double axisMin,
                double axisMax, Rectangle2D area, boolean inverted) {
            double min = area.getMaxY();
            double max = area.getY();
            double fraction = (java2DValue - min) / (max - min);
            if (inverted) {
                return axisMax - fraction * (axisMax - axisMin);
            }
            return axisMin + fraction * (axisMax - axisMin);
        }
    }

    /** Maps axis edges to coordinate conversion strategies. */
    private static final java.util.Map<RectangleEdge, Java2DConversionStrategy>
            JAVA_2D_CONVERSION_STRATEGIES
            = new java.util.HashMap<RectangleEdge, Java2DConversionStrategy>();
    static {
        Java2DConversionStrategy horizontal = new HorizontalJava2DStrategy();
        Java2DConversionStrategy vertical = new VerticalJava2DStrategy();
        JAVA_2D_CONVERSION_STRATEGIES.put(RectangleEdge.TOP, horizontal);
        JAVA_2D_CONVERSION_STRATEGIES.put(RectangleEdge.BOTTOM, horizontal);
        JAVA_2D_CONVERSION_STRATEGIES.put(RectangleEdge.LEFT, vertical);
        JAVA_2D_CONVERSION_STRATEGIES.put(RectangleEdge.RIGHT, vertical);

    /**
     * Creates a default range when no data is available.
     *
     * @return A default range.
     */
    private Range createDefaultAutoRange() {
        if (this.timeline instanceof SegmentedTimeline) {
            long start = ((SegmentedTimeline) this.timeline).getStartTime();
            return new DateRange(start, start + 1);
        }
        return new DateRange();
    }

    /**
     * Calculates the auto-range bounds from the supplied data range.
     *
     * @param r  the data range.
     *
     * @return The adjusted range.
     */
    private DateRange calculateAutoRangeBounds(Range r) {
        long upper = this.timeline.toTimelineValue((long) r.getUpperBound());
        long lower;
        long fixedAutoRange = (long) getFixedAutoRange();
        if (fixedAutoRange > 0.0) {
            lower = upper - fixedAutoRange;
        }
        else {
            lower = this.timeline.toTimelineValue((long) r.getLowerBound());
            double range = upper - lower;
            long minRange = (long) getAutoRangeMinimumSize();
            if (range < minRange) {
                long expand = (long) (minRange - range) / 2;
                upper = upper + expand;
                lower = lower - expand;
            }
            upper = upper + (long) (range * getUpperMargin());
            lower = lower - (long) (range * getLowerMargin());
        }

        upper = this.timeline.toMillisecond(upper);
        lower = this.timeline.toMillisecond(lower);
        return new DateRange(new Date(lower), new Date(upper));
    }

     * anchor strategy.

     * @param dataArea  the data area.
     * @param edge  the axis edge.

     *
     * @return A list of ticks.

    private List refreshTicks(Graphics2D g2, Rectangle2D dataArea,
            RectangleEdge edge, TickLabelAnchorStrategy anchorStrategy) {

        List result = new java.util.ArrayList();

        Font tickLabelFont = getTickLabelFont();
        g2.setFont(tickLabelFont);

        if (isAutoTickUnitSelection()) {
            selectAutoTickUnit(g2, dataArea, edge);
        }

        DateTickUnit unit = getTickUnit();
        Date tickDate = calculateLowestVisibleTickValue(unit);
        Date upperDate = getMaximumDate();

        boolean hasRolled = false;
        while (tickDate.before(upperDate)) {
            if (!hasRolled) {
                tickDate = correctTickDateForPosition(tickDate, unit,
                        this.tickMarkPosition);
            }

            long lowestTickTime = tickDate.getTime();
            Date nextTickDate = unit.addToDate(tickDate, this.timeZone);
            long nextTickTime = nextTickDate.getTime();
            long distance = nextTickTime - lowestTickTime;
            addMinorTicksBefore(result, lowestTickTime, distance, unit);

            if (!isHiddenValue(tickDate.getTime())) {
                String tickLabel = formatTickLabel(tickDate);
                TickAnchor ta = anchorStrategy.getAnchor(edge,
                        isVerticalTickLabels());
                Tick tick = new DateTick(tickDate, tickLabel, ta.anchor,
                        ta.rotationAnchor, ta.angle);
                result.add(tick);
                hasRolled = false;

                addMinorTicksAfter(result, lowestTickTime, nextTickTime, unit);
                tickDate = nextTickDate;
            }
            else {
                tickDate = unit.rollDate(tickDate, this.timeZone);
                hasRolled = true;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

        for (int minorTick = 1; minorTick < minorTickSpaces; minorTick++) {

            if (minorTickTime > 0 && getRange().contains(minorTickTime)

private Log4jLogEvent(final Builder builder) {
    this.loggerName = builder.loggerName;
    this.marker = builder.marker;
    this.loggerFqcn = builder.loggerFqcn;
    this.level = builder.level == null ? Level.OFF : builder.level;
    this.message = builder.message;
    this.thrown = builder.thrown;
    this.thrownProxy = builder.thrownProxy;
    this.contextMap = builder.contextMap == null ? ThreadContext.EMPTY_MAP : builder.contextMap;
    this.contextStack = builder.contextStack == null ? ThreadContext.EMPTY_STACK : builder.contextStack;
    this.timeMillis = builder.message instanceof TimestampMessage
            ? ((TimestampMessage) builder.message).getTimestamp()
            : builder.timeMillis;
    this.threadName = builder.threadName;
    this.source = builder.source;
    if (builder.message != null && builder.message instanceof LoggerNameAwareMessage) {
        ((LoggerNameAwareMessage) builder.message).setLoggerName(builder.loggerName);
    }
    this.nanoTime = builder.nanoTime;
}

public static Log4jLogEvent deserialize(final Serializable event) {
    Objects.requireNonNull(event, "Event cannot be null");
    if (event instanceof LogEventProxy) {
        final LogEventProxy proxy = (LogEventProxy) event;
        final Log4jLogEvent result = new Log4jLogEvent(
                new LoggerInfo(proxy.loggerName, proxy.marker, proxy.loggerFQCN, proxy.level),
                new MessageInfo(proxy.message, proxy.thrown, proxy.thrownProxy),
                new ContextInfo(proxy.contextMap, proxy.contextStack),
                new ThreadInfo(proxy.threadName, proxy.source, proxy.timeMillis, proxy.nanoTime));
        result.setEndOfBatch(proxy.isEndOfBatch);
        result.setIncludeLocation(proxy.isLocationRequired);
        return result;
    }
    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Event is not a serialized LogEvent: " + event.toString());
}
